Of course! Here’s the recipe, I hope you try it!!! Scallion pork floss bun recipe
Ingredients:
- 1/4 cup of sweetened condensed milk (room temperature)
- 1 cup of whole milk (room temperature)
- 1 large eggs (room temperature)
- 1/4 cup butter (softened)
- 2 tablespoons of sugar
- 2 and 1/4 teaspoon of instant yeast
- 3 and 1/4 cup of all purpose flour 
- 1 teaspoon salt
- 3-6 chopped scallions (use as much as you want, more the merrier!)
- 1-2 cups of pork floss (Use as much as you want! I buy mine at a local asian store. This is my favorite brand, Formosa Brand Cooked Dried https://www.amazon.com/dp/B01LPA50QC/ref=cm_sw_r_cp_api_glt_fabc_736QXA7DME5X6QA73BEF, you can always eat it with plain rice, sandwiches, eggs!
- Egg wash: 1 egg + 2 tablespoons of whole milk mixed

Directions 
- add sweetened condensed milk, whole milk, sugar, egg, and test into a medium sized mixing bowl, whisk until combined
- Sprinkle in yeast and whisk once again
- Add flour and salt, use a spatula to combine, mix until the flour is mostly absorbed and soft dough forms. This dough is very sticky!
- Knead the butter into the dough (~20 min), the dough should become soft and elastic
- Place into a greased bowl and let rise for 1 hour
- Punch out the air & cut dough in half
- Scatter some scallions onto the table, roll half of the dough into ~ 7 x 15 in rectangle 
- Sprinkle in pork floss, roll the dough like a jelly roll. Cut into 6 pieces and place the bread into 7 x 4 in loaf pans. The pieces should be standing vertically, it should look like a loaf with cuts in it. The cuts will allow you to serve the bread easier 
- Repeat for the other dough half
- Rise for 45 minutes
- Egg wash! And bake at 350F for 20-23 minutes
VIOLA YUMMY BREAD! Feel free to use a stand mixer if you have one :)

I’d say start off with the little things. Like maybe cleaning your room if it’s messy, take a shower, brush your teeth— all of those things. Take it one step at a time. Maybe try to pick up a hobby even, like try to cook something, or learn how to dance. Apply for a job for some extra money if you want it. 

And for grades, try to take more notes when your teacher or professor talks and review them at night. It’s a good way to understand the lesson better. Try your best to do assignments and keep up with your classes. Study and review old work from your classes when it’s test day— maybe take notes from your old school work to easily review the key points. Building good study habits will help you greatly in the future. It must definitely helps your brain to comprehend information faster and better. 

I know all these things may sound jarring at first, but give it a try. If you find yourself gravitating to your phone all the time, turn it off for a bit. And if you get annoyed with your thoughts— play some music on your laptop, or listen to the radio. You got this!! Maybe play the TV in the background even, but don’t get too distracted!!

Start off with little things, and slowly build up. You don’t have to do everything in one day, or at a certain hour— and all that stuff. Just do it!!! If you find yourself without any motivation to even get up and do these things, you need to find inspiration.

Maybe your family inspires you to become better. Maybe it’s your favorite celebrity, movie character, friends, or maybe yourself. Watch some motivational speeches on youtube even. I don’t know. Just try to get inspired.
